clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar’s Drag, Zamja teaches Horde travelers to cook. The Darkspear troll trains cooks to make meals from beasts of Kalimdor.

Zamja works in the Drag, where she cuts meat and teaches Horde travelers to cook. Cooking helps travelers in the rugged lands of Durotar and the Barrens turn raw game into rations. Cooks who have mastered basic recipes can seek further training in Gadgetzan, to the south.
